title: Connecting the Conflicts
statement: The task is to join a forest of k trees (total size up to 2·10^5) with k−1 new edges into one tree maximizing its maximum independent set. Extra edges never enlarge it, so the sum of per-tree maxima is the bound, reached by attaching every tree to a hub some maximum set avoids (a leaf's neighbour, or via tree DP); all-singleton forests take a star.
